svg.title: Architecture: front doors, one dispatch, eight layers, one ledger
svg.desc: Kshana's architecture in layers. Five front doors (command line, Python, JavaScript and WebAssembly, the MCP server and the JetBrains plugin) reach one api::run_toml, a typed dispatch over 75 kinds. Beneath it sit eight domain layers: Time and frames (timescales · jd2 · precession, nutation · cio · frames · eop); Clocks and timing (allan · clock_state · holdover, telecom_timing · slot_timing); Inertial and fusion (inertial · fusion · kalman, mapmatch · gravimeter · altpnt); GNSS and integrity (gnss_sim · pvt · raim · sbas, jamming · spectrum · spoof_*); Astrodynamics (sgp4 · tle · propagator · forces, orbit_determination · maneuver); LEO PNT (leo_signal · leo_pass, leo_navmsg · leo_fusion · chain); Moon, Mars, deep space (lunar_* · mars_pnt · radiometric, deepspace_od · ccsds_tdm); Missions and studies (campaign · constellation, passes · resilience · study). All of them rest on a shared core (types, scenario, the run record) and are cross-referenced by the verification module, the machine-checked matrix of 223 capabilities that is the single source of truth for every VALIDATED, MODELLED or PARTNER label.
